workflow.critical: The workflow execution engine is governed by: {project-root}/_bmad/core/tasks/workflow.xml
You MUST have already loaded and processed: {installed_path}/workflow.yaml
Communicate all responses in {communication_language} and language MUST be tailored to {user_skill_level}
Linear is the single source of truth - read story context from Linear issue description
Execute ALL steps in exact order; do NOT skip steps

Absolutely DO NOT stop because of "milestones", "significant progress", or "session boundaries". Continue in a single execution until the story is COMPLETE (all ACs satisfied and all tasks checked) UNLESS a HALT condition is triggered or the USER gives other instruction.
Do NOT schedule a "next session" or request review pauses unless a HALT condition applies. Only Step 6 decides completion.
User skill level ({user_skill_level}) affects conversation style ONLY, not code updates.

step.goal: Find next ready story from Linear and load context
step.action: Load {{linear_mapping_file}} to get team_id and project_id

check.if: linear_mapping_file does not exist OR team_id is empty
check.output: Linear mapping not initialized. Run sprint-planning first to configure Linear integration.

step.action: Query Linear for ready stories (Todo status): mcp__linear__list_issues with team={{team_id}}, project={{project_id}}, label="BMAD-Managed", state="Todo"
Filter results to only include stories (exclude parent epic issues by checking for "[Epic-" prefix)
Sort results by title to get ordered story keys

check.if: no ready stories found in Linear
check.output:
📋 No stories with "Todo" status found in Linear.
**Options:** 1. Run `create-story` to add Dev Notes to the next backlog story 2. Check if stories are "In Progress" (may need to resume work) 3. Run `sprint-planning` to see current status
All stories may be completed or still in backlog without Dev Notes.

step.action: Parse first result title to extract story key: "[1-2-name] Title" → "1-2-name"
Store {{linear_issue_id}} from query result
If {{linear_issue_id}} not set, query Linear to find issue: mcp__linear__list_issues with team={{team_id}}, project={{project_id}}, label="BMAD-Managed", query="[{{story_key}}]"
Store {{linear_issue_id}} from query result
Get full issue details: mcp__linear__get_issue with id={{linear_issue_id}}

Parse issue description to extract: - Story statement (As a/I want/So that) - Acceptance Criteria - Dev Notes section (Architecture Guidance, Technical Requirements, Testing Requirements, etc.) - Implementation Tasks with checkboxes

action.if: no Dev Notes section found in description
action.output:
⚠️ Story [{{story_key}}] does not have Dev Notes.
Run `create-story` first to add comprehensive Dev Notes to this story.
action.action: Load comprehensive context from Dev Notes section of Linear issue description
Extract developer guidance: architecture requirements, previous learnings, technical specifications
Parse Implementation Tasks to identify first incomplete task (unchecked [ ])

step.goal: Load project context and extract implementation guidance
step.critical: Load all available context to inform implementation
step.action: Load {project_context} for coding standards and project-wide patterns (if exists)

From Linear issue description, extract and organize: - Architecture Guidance section - Technical Requirements section - Testing Requirements section - Previous Story Learnings section - Implementation Tasks breakdown
step.output:
✅ **Context Loaded from Linear**
**Architecture Guidance:** [summary] **Technical Stack:** [from Dev Notes] **Testing Framework:** [from Dev Notes]
Ready to implement tasks.

step.goal: Detect review continuation and extract review context
step.critical: Determine if this is a fresh start or continuation after code review
step.action: Get comments on Linear issue: mcp__linear__list_comments with issueId={{linear_issue_id}}
Check for code review comments (containing "Code Review" or "Review Findings")

check.if: code review comment exists with unresolved items
check.action: Extract from code review comment: - Review outcome - Action items (look for unchecked [ ] items) - Severity breakdown
check.output:
⏯️ **Resuming Story After Code Review**
**Review Outcome:** {{review_outcome}} **Action Items:** {{unchecked_review_count}} remaining to address
**Strategy:** Will prioritize review follow-up items before continuing with regular tasks.

step.action: Update Linear issue to "In Progress" state: mcp__linear__update_issue with id={{linear_issue_id}}, state="In Progress"
Add comment noting work started: mcp__linear__create_comment with issueId={{linear_issue_id}}, body="Development started on story."
step.output: 🚀 Starting work on story {{story_key}} Linear issue updated: Todo → In Progress

step.critical: FOLLOW THE IMPLEMENTATION TASKS FROM LINEAR ISSUE EXACTLY AS WRITTEN - NO DEVIATION
step.action: Review the current task from the Linear issue Dev Notes - this is your authoritative implementation guide
Plan implementation following red-green-refactor cycle
Write FAILING tests first for the task functionality
Confirm tests fail before implementation - this validates test correctness
Implement MINIMAL code to make tests pass
Run tests to confirm they now pass
Handle error conditions and edge cases as specified in task
Improve code structure while keeping tests green
Ensure code follows architecture patterns from Dev Notes

action.if: new dependencies required beyond story specifications

step.action: HALT: "Additional dependencies need user approval"
HALT and request guidance
HALT: "Cannot proceed without necessary configuration files"
step.critical: NEVER implement anything not in the Implementation Tasks from Linear issue
NEVER proceed to next task until current task is complete AND tests pass
Execute continuously without pausing until all tasks complete or explicit HALT condition

step.action: Create unit tests for business logic and core functionality introduced/changed by the task
Add integration tests for component interactions specified in story requirements
Include end-to-end tests for critical user flows when story requirements demand them
Cover edge cases and error handling scenarios identified in Dev Notes
Determine how to run tests for this repo (infer test framework from project structure)
Run all existing tests to ensure no regressions
Run the new tests to verify implementation correctness
Run linting and code quality checks if configured in project
Validate implementation meets ALL story acceptance criteria
STOP and fix before continuing
STOP and fix before continuing

step.critical: NEVER mark a task complete unless ALL conditions are met
step.action: Verify ALL tests for this task ACTUALLY EXIST and PASS 100%
Confirm implementation matches EXACTLY what the task specifies
Validate that ALL acceptance criteria related to this task are satisfied
Run full test suite to ensure NO regressions introduced

check.if: ALL validation gates pass AND tests ACTUALLY exist and pass
check.action: Note task as completed in local tracking
Track files created/modified for this task
DO NOT mark task complete - fix issues first
HALT if unable to fix validation failures

step.action: Determine if more incomplete tasks remain in Implementation Tasks list

step.goal: Story completion and mark for review in Linear
step.action: Verify ALL tasks from Implementation Tasks are completed
Run the full regression suite (do not skip)
Execute enhanced definition-of-done validation

Validate definition-of-done checklist: - All Implementation Tasks completed - Implementation satisfies every Acceptance Criterion from Linear issue - Unit tests for core functionality added/updated - Integration tests for component interactions added when required - End-to-end tests for critical flows added when story demands them - All tests pass (no regressions, new tests successful) - Code quality checks pass (linting, static analysis if configured)
Update Linear issue to "In Review" state: mcp__linear__update_issue with id={{linear_issue_id}}, state="In Review"
step.output: ✅ Story status updated to "In Review" in Linear
step.action: HALT - Complete remaining tasks before marking ready for review
HALT - Fix regression issues before completing
HALT - Address DoD failures before completing
Prepare a concise summary of implementation
Communicate to {user_name} that story implementation is complete and ready for review
Summarize key accomplishments: story key, key changes made, tests added, files modified
Provide the Linear issue link and current status (now "In Review")

Based on {user_skill_level}, ask if user needs any explanations about: - What was implemented and how it works - Why certain technical decisions were made - How to test or verify the changes - Any patterns, libraries, or approaches used

check.action: Provide clear, contextual explanations tailored to {user_skill_level}

step.action: Recommended next steps: - Review the implemented story in Linear - Verify all acceptance criteria are met - Run `code-review` workflow for peer review
step.output: 💡 **Tip:** For best results, run `code-review` using a **different** LLM than the one that implemented this story.
